purpose: Run the same finite two-trait evolution experiment for all four assurance settings, then promote only tradeoff settings that independently pass the frozen rare-mutant joint-shift gate.

promotion_eligibility.tradeoff_setting: central state joint_shift_gate_pass == true AND at least 36 of 45 resident states joint_shift_gate_pass == true

history_endpoint.unit: history x initial_state; average the four demographic repeats within each near/far arm, requiring terminal occupation in both paired arms for trait classification
history_endpoint.syndrome_class: far-minus-near terminal investment <= -0.05 AND far-minus-near terminal assurance >= +0.05
history_endpoint.outcross_class: far-minus-near terminal investment >= +0.05 AND far-minus-near terminal assurance <= -0.05
history_endpoint.occupancy: report unconditionally before excluding extinct trait endpoints
history_endpoint.eligibility: all four demographic repeats must be terminally occupied in both near and far arms; otherwise the history remains in occupancy summaries but receives no trait class

branching.history_branching: within a fixed setting and initial state, both syndrome_class and outcross_class each >=10% of eligible histories
branching.initial_state_dependence: endpoint-class frequencies differ across the three initial states; report descriptively and with multinomial/permutation comparison if sample size permits
branching.repeatability_core: at least one promotion-eligible tradeoff setting has history_branching in at least one initial state, and syndrome/outcross/intermediate class agreement across the frozen 2-vs-2 split halves is >=0.70 among histories classifiable in both halves
branching.split_half_classification: each 2-repeat half is classified by its paired far-minus-near mean using the same endpoint deadbands; requires both repeats occupied in both arms

fixed_delta_boundary: delta remains fixed at the setting value inherited from the bridge; no purging feedback
